title: 第678章 老神仙日常678第677章 老神仙日常677
content_zh:
“怕？！”韩烈瞪圆了眼睛，“怕什么怕？我怕你？别逗了！”
林彦廷勾着唇角笑了笑，“习惯性反驳。”
“嗯？”韩烈半张着口，见林彦廷对着自己笑了笑，他后知后觉地闭紧了嘴巴。
林彦廷朝着韩烈抬了抬下巴，见烈少那双圆眼睛朝着自己眨了眨，他心情很好地挑了挑眉，接着缓缓闭了闭眼睛，说了句，“别动昂~”
韩烈心脏噗通跳了一下，他舔了舔唇，不由自主地点了点头。
林彦廷心情又好了些，他伸出了手，拇指按住了韩烈的下眼睑，食指轻轻按住了韩烈的上眼皮，双指微微用力，扒开了韩烈的眼皮，俯身看了过去。
韩烈只觉自己的心脏要从嗓子眼里跳出来，下意识地，他伸手推开了趴在自己眼前的人，“你做什么？”
林彦廷又笑了笑，他直起了身体，做了个深呼吸的动作，“跟着我一起做。”
韩烈蹙眉，这功夫，林彦廷已经做了三组深呼吸，他不由得也跟着做了起来。
见韩烈做起了深呼吸，林彦廷便停下了动作，他心中默默数着，数了三十下，朝韩烈摆了摆手，“好了。”
韩烈深吸了一口气，停下了动作，抬着眼眸看着林彦廷，心中疑惑这人到底要做些什么。
“眼底充血。”
韩烈莫名其妙地点了点头。
林彦廷笑了笑，举了举听诊器，“我现在要听你的心跳和肺音。”
韩烈怔了怔，又莫名其妙地点了头。
林彦廷微微颔首，伸手解开了韩烈的外套纽扣，将听诊器顺着韩烈的衬衣伸了进去。
韩烈低头看了过去，他看着自己衣服里鼓起的那块慢慢移动，方才缓了下来的心跳蓦的又跳快了些。
林彦廷抬眸看了过去，轻蹙了下眉头，立刻又松开。
他抬起了手腕，一边听，一边计时。
到了时间，他将听诊器从韩烈的衬衣里抽了出来，一抬眸，他见韩烈看着自己发呆，摘下了听诊器，他回手拍了拍韩烈的胳膊，“扣好扣子，再麻烦烈少挪个座位。”

韩烈“嗯？”了一声，垂眸去看，他伸手拢住了自己的衣领，蓦的红了耳根。
林彦廷见烈少反应迟钝一般地还坐在自己的位置上，他哼笑了一声，摇了摇头，从抽屉里摸出了自己的工作笔记本，一抬腿自己坐在了桌子上。
翻开了笔记本，他俯身写道，“姓名，韩烈，年龄……”
他抬眼看了过去，“你多大？”
“二、二十四。”
“二十四？”林彦廷微微睁了睁眼睛，“上几年级？”
韩烈撇了撇嘴角，“研二。”
“嗯~”林彦廷点了点头，斜睨了一眼韩烈，“在哪里读书？”
“关你……”后面的话还没说出口，韩烈变了主意，“在美国……”
“要读博士吗？”林彦廷停了笔，认真打量起了眼前的人。
韩烈深吸了一口气，掀起眼皮看着眼前这姓林的，“不一定，没想好。”
林彦廷点了点头，“是要好好想一想，你现在的状况，不一定适合读博士。”
韩烈舔了舔唇，渐渐垂下了眼眸。
content_en:
"Afraid?!" Han Lie's eyes widened, "What are you afraid of? Am I afraid of you? Stop being ridiculous!"
Lin Yanting raised the corners of his lips and smiled, "It's a habit to refute."
"Huh?" Han Lie half-opened his mouth, but when he saw Lin Yanting smiling at him, he closed his mouth after realizing it.
Lin Yanting raised his chin towards Han Lie and saw Lie Shao's round eyes blinking at him. He raised his eyebrows in a good mood, then slowly closed his eyes and said, "Don't move~"
Han Lie's heart skipped a beat. He licked his lips and nodded involuntarily.
Lin Yanting was in a better mood again. He stretched out his hand, pressed his thumb on Han Lie's lower eyelid, and his index finger gently pressed on Han Lie's upper eyelid. With a little force, he opened Han Lie's eyelids and leaned over to look over.
Han Lie felt that his heart was about to jump out of his throat. Subconsciously, he reached out and pushed away the person lying in front of him, "What are you doing?"
Lin Yanting smiled again. He straightened up and took a deep breath. "Follow me."
Han Lie frowned. At this time, Lin Yanting had already taken three sets of deep breaths, and he couldn't help but follow suit.
Seeing Han Lie taking a deep breath, Lin Yanting stopped. He counted thirty times silently in his heart, and waved his hand to Han Lie, "Okay."
Han Lie took a deep breath, stopped his movements, raised his eyes and looked at Lin Yanting, wondering what on earth this man was going to do.
"The eyes are bloodshot."
Han Lie nodded inexplicably.
Lin Yanting smiled and raised the stethoscope, "I want to listen to your heartbeat and lung sounds now."
Han Lie was startled, then nodded inexplicably.
Lin Yanting nodded slightly, reached out to unbutton Han Lie's coat, and inserted the stethoscope along Han Lie's shirt.
Han Lie lowered his head and looked over. He watched the bulge in his clothes move slowly, and his heartbeat that had just slowed down suddenly beat faster again.
Lin Yanting raised his eyes and looked over, frowned slightly, and immediately relaxed.
He raised his wrist, listening and counting.
When the time came, he took the stethoscope out of Han Lie's shirt. When he raised his eyes, he saw Han Lie looking at him in a daze and took off the stethoscope. He returned and patted Han Lie's arm, "Button it up and please move to your seat, Mr. Lie."
Han Lie said "huh?" and lowered his eyes to look. He stretched out his hand to hold his collar, and his ears suddenly turned red.
Lin Yanting saw that Mr. Lie was still sitting in his seat as if he was unresponsive. He chuckled, shook his head, took out his work notebook from the drawer, raised his legs and sat on the table.
Opening the notebook, he leaned over and wrote, "Name, Han Lie, age..."
He looked up and asked, "How old are you?"
"Two, twenty-four."
"Twenty-four?" Lin Yanting opened his eyes slightly, "What grade are you in?"
Han Lie curled his lips and said, "Yan Er."
"Hmm~" Lin Yanting nodded and glanced sideways at Han Lie, "Where are you studying?"
"It's none of your business..." Before he could say the next words, Han Lie changed his mind, "In the United States..."
"Do you want to study for a Ph.D.?" Lin Yanting stopped writing and carefully looked at the person in front of him.
Han Lie took a deep breath, raised his eyelids and looked at the man named Lin in front of him, "Not necessarily, I haven't thought about it."
Lin Yanting nodded, "You have to think about it carefully. Your current situation may not be suitable for you to study for a Ph.D."
Han Lie licked his lips and gradually lowered his eyes.
